svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Ingestion pipeline
svg.desc: Ten steps from the presigned upload to the indexed document, including OCR, speech to text and the knowledge graph.
svg.text: Permanent (invalid file, malware, policy, page or audio limit, no speech) → failed / rejected, no retry. Transient (DB, S3, model, ClamAV) → retries, DLQ after 4 receives.
Processing is idempotent per job and version. Reindexing reuses the originals in S3 (runbook reindex.md).
